Description: The system shall allow users to perform Admin login using username and password
Upon successful login the system shall redirect to adminview.html; upon failure it shall display an error message
The system shall support a Remember Me option that maintains login state for 10 days via Cookie max-age
When an already-logged-in user navigates to adminlogin.html the system shall automatically redirect them to adminview.html
The system shall allow users to log out and immediately invalidate the login Cookie
When an unauthenticated user accesses adminview.html the system shall redirect them to the login page
The Admin view shall display all Todo List names together with their item counts including active completed and total
Users shall be able to create a new Todo List by entering a name where spaces are automatically replaced with hyphens
Users shall be able to delete a Todo List after confirming via a dialog prompt
Users shall be able to rename a Todo List by double-clicking; the operation shall fail if the new name already exists or the original does not exist
Users shall be able to add a new Todo item to a specified List; input consisting only of whitespace shall not create an item
Users shall be able to mark or unmark a Todo item as completed
Users shall be able to edit the text of a Todo item by double-clicking; saving an empty title shall delete the item
Users shall be able to delete a single Todo item
Users shall be able to toggle all Todo items to completed or active using a single control
Users shall be able to filter Todo items by All Active or Completed status
Users shall be able to clear all completed Todo items at once
All Todo data shall be stored in browser localStorage and persist across page refreshes
Admin credentials shall not be exposed in client-side source code in any reversibly encoded form
The login state Cookie shall have HttpOnly and Secure flags set to prevent XSS-based theft
All Todo content shall be HTML-escaped before rendering to prevent XSS injection
Data shall persist across normal browser sessions and shall not be lost on page refresh
The system shall handle localStorage quota exhaustion gracefully without data corruption
Destructive operations such as deleting a List shall require user confirmation to prevent accidental loss
When an operation fails such as a rename conflict the system shall display a visible error message to the user
All interactive operations shall respond within an acceptable time under normal usage conditions
